fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the performance and application of the mortar, such as its load-bearing capacity and ease of handling.

fields.name: installation_method
fields.rationale: The installation method is crucial for understanding the application process and compatibility with other systems, such as the Hilti SAFEset concept.
evidence: Hilti SAFEset is an approved system which makes anchor installation an easier, safer and faster process.
When use with Hilti HIT-Z rod as part of the SAFEset, no cleaning of the borehole is required.
inference_basis: SAFEset concept implies specific installation methods.
